variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of a long, low, off-white #F4F2EE matte shelf surface running the full width of the frame at about 68% of the frame height, against a seamless pale cool-grey #E5E9EA wall. The top band of the frame, about 20% of the height, is intentionally empty, calm and low-detail for headline copy added later. The middle band along the shelf, from 20% to 68% of the height and across 80% of the width, is intentionally empty, evenly lit open space reserved for three photos placed later, with nothing standing on the shelf. Lighting: soft even daylight from the upper left at 5600K, very soft shadows falling slightly to the lower right. Background: pale cool-grey #E5E9EA wall, matte, subtle plaster texture. Style: bathroom shelf restraint, uncluttered, single light source. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
